comment: The xFD CV sumRange is a sweep position, not a voltage: knob plus CV is clamped to 0-1, which is 0% to 100%. This module is mono only, unlike sickoCrosser. The three L buttons sit between the four channels, so each links a channel to its right-hand neighbour and the fourth channel has none of its own. With Link Mode set to 'xFD + Inputs', the outputs of the linked channels other than the first are held at 0V (SickoCrosser4.cpp:216-223). The signal jacks carry whatever is patched, so they get no family. Under Link Mode 'xFD + Inputs' the linked channels' inputs are pooled into one crossfade driven by the first channel's xFD knob and sent to its output; under 'xFD only' each channel keeps its own inputs and output and only the knob positions are ganged.
